definitions.explanation: A written record made so as not to forget something. Can refer to a physical notebook, a document, or a digital note kept as a personal reminder.

examples.japanese: {備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I summarized the contents of the meeting in a memorandum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}き{留|と}めて→書き留める：06730_kakitomeru⟧おこう。
examples.english: Let me jot it down in my memo before I forget.

examples.japanese: ⟦ブログ→ブログ：05104_burogu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せた→載せる：28290_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I posted photos on my blog as a travel memo.

notes:
Literally "record for preparing against forgetting" — a somewhat formal or literary word for a memorandum or reminder note. In modern usage, often used as a blog title or subtitle meaning "notes to self."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to keep a memo
- {備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in a memo
- {備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a memorandum
- {備忘録|びぼうろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧: memo — casual, everyday equivalent
- {覚|おぼ}え{書|が}き: memorandum — similar formality, slightly more personal
- {手控|てびか}え: personal notes — kept for one's own reference

FORMS:
{備|び} (prepare) + {忘|ぼう} (forget) + {録|ろく} (record) — a record prepared against forgetting.
